title: THE USE BAR CLEARS THE COUNTDOWN PLATE
why: Old check 19.10 found it: since the countdown moved to a plate (v32.35, v32.36, v32.58) the bandage bar printed across the EXTRACT INBOUND line. The bar now sits 34 px higher, 8 px under the plate.
now: While extraction is inbound the use bar stands above the countdown plate, not across it.

edits.replacement: y=Math.min(y,Math.round(by-(LH(48)+LH(34)+LH(34))*Math.max(1,hudRes())-h));   /* v28.xx (cw-useplate): the inbound banner stands on a plate 38 px above its line since v32.35 and v32.36, 14 px higher since v32.58, so the use bar went another 34 px up and now ends 8 px under that plate, not across the countdown */
